name: Panopto Media Remote
description: Adds Panopto as a media remote provider.
project_description:
The Panopto Media Remote extends the Media Remote module with the ability to add Panopto videos as media items. It provides a Panopto formatter so users can embed Panopto videos in media entity fields and also embed via ckeditor.

 Steps to add Panopto as a media formatter:

 - Enable the Panopto Media Remote module.

- Go to media types page and add a new media type. Choose custom name (e.g. Panopto) and select "Remote Media Url" as the media source.

- Go to "Manage dislay" for the newly created media type and select "Remote Media - Panopto" as the formatter.

- Now you can add a media field to any content type and select the new media type.
